Name: Witchy-Gothic Interior (Alternative Textures and Content Patcher)
Author: Iceprincess98
Description:
This mod is an updated version of strawberrymilk95's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/432]Witchy-Gothic Interior[/url].

There are two versions of the mod you can download, Alternative Textures and Content Patcher.

I'd like to give some info about the CP version:
[list]
[*]The kitchen and crib of the farmhouse will automatically be recolored to the mod's version, this can be individually turned off in the config menu.
[*]Please note that the furniture isn't added to shops directly and can only be spawned in. ﻿To counter this, it is possible to buy a custom furniture catalogue at Robin's with all the items included. For this to work, Calcifer needs to be installed.
[/list][list]
[*]If you don't want the catalogue or change its price, you can do so in the config menu.
[/list]


I used two PIF mods to decorate rooms to make images for the mod, apart from those I only used vanilla items.
The two mods were the following by Sharogg:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28168]Rustic Attic (PIF)[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25552]Balcony (PIF)[/url]﻿
[/list]

Many thanks to strawberrymilk95 for letting me update the mod!

Manifest.Name: (AT) Witchy-Gothic Interior
Manifest.Description: Adds witchy & gothic furniture through Alternative Textures.
Manifest.Author: strawberrymilk95, conversion Iceprincess98

Manifest.Name: (CP) Witchy-Gothic Interior
Manifest.Description: Adds witchy themed decorations and furniture
